properties.text:
InteractionKit Examples: ready-made InteractionKit and UIKit examples to explore and build on.

You start in the Interaction Showcase: pick a showcase on its panel and grab, throw, poke or pinch the objects. Use Previous and Next on the panel below to step through the showcase, the UIKit layouts and the interaction examples, one at a time.

Pinch, poke and grab the content to try each one.

value: InteractionKit and UIKit showcase. Pick a showcase on the far panel: grab and throw the jellyfish, drag the crystal chain, poke the crystal to shrink it, or pinch it to spin and grow it. Each one has its own controls. The Color panel button opens a near panel that tints the crystals and the jellyfish.
UIKit layouts and components: menus, grids, a carousel, a text area, a modal, a card deck and a chat. Scroll the lists and press the buttons.
InteractionKit patterns: grab and move objects, grab the sphere to pilot the spaceship across the galaxy and push the particles along its path, and toggle one- and two-handed scale and rotate modes.

properties.text:
Click Next and Previous to explore the UI examples.
You can use these UIs in your Lens.
The UI elements don’t trigger any actions when pressed, they’re just placeholders.
properties.name: Text

_depthScalingMaximumScale.uiInfo: {"label":"Maximum Scale", "hint":"Uniform scale factor at or farther than the maximum depth.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

_allowScaling.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables interactive scaling of the frame via corner handles."}

_depthScalingMaximumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Maximum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Far endpoint of the depth scaling curve, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

_cutOutCenter.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, creates a transparent center in the frame, allowing content behind the frame to be visible."}

_maximumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Maximum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Farthest camera-forward depth allowed for the grabbed point, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthClamping"}

_cutOutFeather.uiInfo: {"hint":"Softness of the transparent-center cutout edge, in local centimeters. Higher is softer; the shader keeps a small minimum to avoid aliasing."}

yAlways.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame continuously rotates around the Y-axis to face the user, regardless of movement.", "showIf":"yOnTranslate"}

_onlyInteractOnMargin.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, only the margin is interactive for controlling the frame."}

_depthScalingMinimumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Minimum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Near endpoint of the depth scaling curve, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

xBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"hint":"A buffered degrees on the x-axis before the frame billboards to face the user.", "showIf":"xAlways"}

_depthScalingMinimumScale.uiInfo: {"label":"Minimum Scale", "hint":"Uniform scale factor at or nearer than the minimum depth.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

_minimumSize.uiInfo: {"hint":"Minimum dimensions that the frame can be resized to. In local space centimeters."}

_enableInteractionPlane.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables an Interaction Plane that creates a near-field targeting zone around the frame that improves precision when interacting with buttons and UI elements using hand tracking."}

_following.uiInfo: {"hint":"Turns on the following. If this is set to true, it will begin following the user immediately.", "showIf":"useFollowBehavior"}

_hasShadow.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, renders a soft drop shadow behind the frame body."}

_useDepthScaling.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Depth Scaling", "hint":"Updates scale when the Frame moves; camera-only movement does not resize a stationary Frame. Not supported together with Item Snapping."}

_innerSize.uiInfo: {"hint":"Size of the frames's inner content area. In local space centimeters."}

_interactablePadding.uiInfo: {"hint":"Per-side padding (x = horizontal, y = vertical) added to the interaction collider only — widens the grab band around the frame without changing the visible frame size. In local space centimeters."}

useFollowBehavior.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Built-In Follow Behavior", "hint":"When enabled, creates a follow behavior that keeps the frame in front of the user's view.", "showIf":"_showFollowButton"}

_interactionPlaneOffset.uiInfo: {"hint":"Offset position for the interaction plane relative to the frame center.", "showIf":"_enableInteractionPlane"}

_useTiltMode.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Tilt Mode", "hint":"Enables tilt mode, which switches the follow behavior to gaze-tracking when the user looks up or down beyond the configured thresholds.", "showIf":"useFollowBehavior"}

_maximumSize.uiInfo: {"hint":"Maximum dimensions that the frame can be resized to. In local space centimeters."}

_useDepthClamping.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Depth Clamping", "hint":"Keeps the grabbed point between the configured near and far depths during user translation. Has no effect while Allow Translation is off (unless Force Translate is on). Not supported together with Item Snapping."}

_minimumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Minimum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Closest camera-forward depth allowed for the grabbed point, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthClamping"}

_padding.uiInfo: {"hint":"Extra padding that maintains a fixed size in centimeters regardless of frame scaling, useful for toolbars and fixed-size UI elements. In local space centimeters."}

yOnTranslate.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame rotates around the Y-axis to face the user, but only during movement/translation unless yAlways is also enabled.", "showIf":"useBillboarding"}

_showCloseButton.uiInfo: {"hint":"Shows a button that allows users to close or dismiss the frame."}

_showFollowButton.uiInfo: {"hint":"Shows a button that allows users to toggle whether the frame follows their view as they move."}

_useTagAlong.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Tag-Along Mode", "hint":"Replaces smooth follow with tag-along: the frame stays still during small head movements and recenters after larger turns."}

_spawnOnStart.uiInfo: {"hint":"Play the Horizon Reveal spawn animation when the frame starts."}

allowNonUniformScaling.uiInfo: {"hint":"Allows independent width/height scaling, clamped to min/max sizes.", "showIf":"_allowScaling"}

_tagAlongDistance.uiInfo: {"label":"Follow Distance", "hint":"Distance (cm) at which the frame repositions in front of the user.", "widget":"slider", "min":20, "max":200, "step":1, "showIf":"_useTagAlong"}

_targetingVisual.uiInfo:
{"hint":"Sets the preferred targeting visual. An enclosing InteractionPlane overrides this unless Ignore Interaction Plane is set.

- 0: None
- 1: Cursor (default)
- 2: Ray", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Cursor", "value":1}, {"label":"Ray", "value":2}], "showIf":"_enableInteractionPlane"}

worldSnapping.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables snapping to physical surfaces in the real-world environment when moving.", "showIf":"useSnapping"}

xOnTranslate.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame rotates around the X-axis to face the user, but only during movement/translation unless xAlways is also enabled.", "showIf":"useBillboarding"}

_tiltDownThreshold.uiInfo: {"label":"Tilt Down Threshold (degrees)", "hint":"Camera pitch angle looking down at which gaze-tracking activates.", "widget":"slider", "min":0, "max":90, "step":1, "showIf":"_useTiltMode"}

_tiltUpThreshold.uiInfo: {"label":"Tilt Up Threshold (degrees)", "hint":"Camera pitch angle looking up at which gaze-tracking activates.", "widget":"slider", "min":0, "max":90, "step":1, "showIf":"_useTiltMode"}

_useFocusFrame.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Focus Frame", "hint":"When enabled, a text field inside this frame moves the whole frame toward the system keyboard while editing, pausing the frame's follow behavior until editing ends."}

autoScaleContent.uiInfo: {"hint":"Automatically scales child content when the frame is resized to maintain proportions."}

itemSnapping.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables snapping to other frames when moving. Not supported together with Depth Clamping/Scaling, which are disabled while this is active.", "showIf":"useSnapping"}

relativeZ.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, Z-axis scaling of content will match X-axis scaling during frame resizing."}

useBillboarding.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables the frame to automatically rotate to face the camera/user."}

useSnapping.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables frame snapping functionality for automatic alignment to other frames or world features when moved."}

xAlways.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame continuously rotates around the X-axis to face the user, regardless of movement.", "showIf":"xOnTranslate"}

yBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"hint":"A buffered degrees on the y-axis before the frame billboards to face the user.", "showIf":"yAlways"}

statusTextObject.uiInfo: {"hint":"Scene object that has the Text component to update (inside the existing Frame)"}

enableInstantDrag.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Instant Drag", "hint":"Enable this to allow the Interactable to instantly be dragged on trigger rather than obeying the Interactor's drag threshold."}

useFilteredPinch.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Filtered Pinch", "hint":"Determines if the Interactable should listen to filtered pinch events when targeted by a HandInteractor. Filtered pinch events are more stable when the hand is quickly moving but may add latency in non-moving cases. Most interactions should use raw pinch events by default. Spatial interactions with large hand movement (such as dragging, scrolling) should use filtered pinch events. If an Interactable has a parent Interactable that uses filtered pinch events, this Interactable will also use filtered pinch events."}

acceptableXDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"X", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the X-axis:
- None: Disables X-axis poke detection.
- Right: Finger must approach from +X direction.
- Left: Finger must approach from -X direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Right", "value":1}, {"label":"Left", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

acceptableYDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"Y", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the Y-axis:
- None: Disables Y-axis poke detection.
- Top: Finger must approach from +Y direction.
- Bottom: Finger must approach from -Y direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Top", "value":1}, {"label":"Bottom", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

enablePokeDirectionality.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Poke Directionality", "hint":"Enable Poke Directionality to help prevent accidental interactions when users approach from unwanted angles. When enabled, you can specify which directions are valid for poke interactions on each axis."}

acceptableZDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"Z", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the Z-axis:
- None: Disables Z-axis poke detection.
- Front: Finger must approach from +Z direction.
- Back: Finger must approach from -Z direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Front", "value":1}, {"label":"Back", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

allowMultipleInteractors.uiInfo: {"label":"Allow Multiple Interactors", "hint":"Determines whether this Interactable can be simultaneously controlled by multiple Interactors. When false, only one Interactor type (e.g., left hand or right hand) can interact at a time. Set to true to enable interactions from multiple sources simultaneously, such as allowing both hands to manipulate the Interactable at once."}

ignoreInteractionPlane.uiInfo: {"label":"Ignore Interaction Plane", "hint":"When enabled, this Interactable ignores any parent InteractionPlane and factors into the cursor's position and targetingVisual. Use when the Interactable is parented for organization but not spatially within that plane."}

includeCollidersInPhysics.uiInfo: {"label":"Include Colliders In Physics", "hint":"When enabled, this Interactable's colliders also participate in Lens physics: they collide with physics bodies and respond to Physics raycasts and overlap and collision events. Leave off (default) if the colliders are only used for interaction; this keeps them out of the physics simulation for better performance."}

isScrollable.uiInfo: {"label":"Is Scrollable", "hint":"When true, interactions with this element can scroll a parent ScrollView that has content extending beyond its visible bounds."}

keepHoverOnTrigger.uiInfo: {"label":"Keep Hover On Trigger", "hint":"When enabled, the Interactable exhibits sticky behavior during trigger - the cursor locks on the Interactable and remains in an active visual state even after de-hovering. This is the singular source of truth for feedback, UI, and cursor components."}

targetingMode.uiInfo:
{"label":"Targeting Mode", "hint":"Defines how Interactors can target and interact with this Interactable. Options include:
- Direct: Only allows close pinch interactions where a hand directly touches the Interactable.
- Indirect: Allows interactions from a distance with raycasting.
- Direct/Indirect: Supports both direct and indirect interaction methods.
- Poke: Enables finger poking interactions.
- All: Supports all targeting modes (Direct, Indirect, and Poke).", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Direct", "value":1}, {"label":"Indirect", "value":2}, {"label":"Direct/Indirect", "value":3}, {"label":"Poke", "value":4}, {"label":"All", "value":7}]}

distanceHandMax.uiInfo: {"hint":"Wrist-to-wrist distance (cm) mapped to hand-dist = 1 (hands far apart)"}

testMode.uiInfo: {"hint":"Simulate hands with the mock objects in the Lens Studio editor. Ignored on device, where real hands are used."}

cubePrefab.uiInfo: {"hint":"Prefab to instantiate. Cubes start hidden and appear when a mode is activated."}

scaleHandDistAxes.uiInfo: {"hint":"Which axes the Hand Distance scale affects. (1,0,0) = X only, (1,1,1) = uniform."}

distancePinchMax.uiInfo: {"hint":"Thumb-to-index distance (cm) → pinch = 0 (fully open). Distances ≥ this clamp to 0."}

distancePinchMin.uiInfo: {"hint":"Thumb-to-index distance (cm) → pinch = 1 (fully closed). Distances ≤ this clamp to 1."}

mockHandA.uiInfo: {"hint":"Simulates the left hand. Animates LEFT along its X-axis."}

mockHandB.uiInfo: {"hint":"Simulates the right hand. Animates RIGHT along its X-axis."}

mockPinchA.uiInfo: {"hint":"Simulates the thumb tip. Spreads DOWN (away from mockPinchB) when pinch = 0 (open)."}

mockPinchB.uiInfo: {"hint":"Simulates the index tip. Spreads UP (away from mockPinchA) when pinch = 0 (open). Both return to rest when pinch = 1 (closed)."}

scalePinchAxes.uiInfo: {"hint":"Which axes the Pinch scale affects. (0,1,0) = Y only, (1,1,1) = uniform. Each component is a 0-1 weight."}

rotateHandDistAxis.uiInfo: {"hint":"World axis the Hand Distance rotation spins around. Default (0,1,0) = Y (spin left/right)."}

rotatePinchAxis.uiInfo: {"hint":"World axis the Pinch rotation spins around. Default (1,0,0) = X (tilt forward/back)."}

rotationAtOne.uiInfo: {"hint":"Rotation (degrees) at input = 1 (shared by both rotation modes)"}

rotationAtZero.uiInfo: {"hint":"Rotation (degrees) at input = 0 (shared by both rotation modes)"}

scaleAtOne.uiInfo: {"hint":"Scale value at input = 1 (shared by both scale modes)"}

scaleAtZero.uiInfo: {"hint":"Scale value at input = 0 (shared by both scale modes)"}

smoothSpeed.uiInfo: {"hint":"How fast cubes follow input — higher = snappier"}

statusText.uiInfo: {"hint":"Text component that displays active modes and live channel values"}

testHandAmplitude.uiInfo: {"hint":"Visual half-amplitude (cm) each hand mock travels. Purely cosmetic — the actual input is always a 0-1 wave and is NOT derived from world positions, so this does not need to match distanceHandMin/Max."}

testPinchAmplitude.uiInfo: {"hint":"Visual half-amplitude (cm) each pinch mock travels. Purely cosmetic — actual input is always 0-1."}

_allowScaling.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables interactive scaling of the frame via corner handles."}

_depthScalingMaximumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Maximum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Far endpoint of the depth scaling curve, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

_cutOutCenter.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, creates a transparent center in the frame, allowing content behind the frame to be visible."}

_maximumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Maximum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Farthest camera-forward depth allowed for the grabbed point, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthClamping"}

_cutOutFeather.uiInfo: {"hint":"Softness of the transparent-center cutout edge, in local centimeters. Higher is softer; the shader keeps a small minimum to avoid aliasing."}

yAlways.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame continuously rotates around the Y-axis to face the user, regardless of movement.", "showIf":"yOnTranslate"}

_onlyInteractOnMargin.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, only the margin is interactive for controlling the frame."}

_depthScalingMinimumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Minimum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Near endpoint of the depth scaling curve, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

xBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"hint":"A buffered degrees on the x-axis before the frame billboards to face the user.", "showIf":"xAlways"}

_depthScalingMinimumScale.uiInfo: {"label":"Minimum Scale", "hint":"Uniform scale factor at or nearer than the minimum depth.", "showIf":"_useDepthScaling"}

_minimumSize.uiInfo: {"hint":"Minimum dimensions that the frame can be resized to. In local space centimeters."}

_enableInteractionPlane.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables an Interaction Plane that creates a near-field targeting zone around the frame that improves precision when interacting with buttons and UI elements using hand tracking."}

_following.uiInfo: {"hint":"Turns on the following. If this is set to true, it will begin following the user immediately.", "showIf":"useFollowBehavior"}

_hasShadow.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, renders a soft drop shadow behind the frame body."}

_useDepthScaling.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Depth Scaling", "hint":"Updates scale when the Frame moves; camera-only movement does not resize a stationary Frame. Not supported together with Item Snapping."}

_innerSize.uiInfo: {"hint":"Size of the frames's inner content area. In local space centimeters."}

_interactablePadding.uiInfo: {"hint":"Per-side padding (x = horizontal, y = vertical) added to the interaction collider only — widens the grab band around the frame without changing the visible frame size. In local space centimeters."}

useFollowBehavior.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Built-In Follow Behavior", "hint":"When enabled, creates a follow behavior that keeps the frame in front of the user's view.", "showIf":"_showFollowButton"}

_interactionPlaneOffset.uiInfo: {"hint":"Offset position for the interaction plane relative to the frame center.", "showIf":"_enableInteractionPlane"}

_useTiltMode.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Tilt Mode", "hint":"Enables tilt mode, which switches the follow behavior to gaze-tracking when the user looks up or down beyond the configured thresholds.", "showIf":"useFollowBehavior"}

_maximumSize.uiInfo: {"hint":"Maximum dimensions that the frame can be resized to. In local space centimeters."}

_useDepthClamping.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Depth Clamping", "hint":"Keeps the grabbed point between the configured near and far depths during user translation. Has no effect while Allow Translation is off (unless Force Translate is on). Not supported together with Item Snapping."}

_minimumDepth.uiInfo: {"label":"Minimum Depth (cm)", "hint":"Closest camera-forward depth allowed for the grabbed point, in centimeters.", "showIf":"_useDepthClamping"}

_padding.uiInfo: {"hint":"Extra padding that maintains a fixed size in centimeters regardless of frame scaling, useful for toolbars and fixed-size UI elements. In local space centimeters."}

yOnTranslate.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame rotates around the Y-axis to face the user, but only during movement/translation unless yAlways is also enabled.", "showIf":"useBillboarding"}

_showCloseButton.uiInfo: {"hint":"Shows a button that allows users to close or dismiss the frame."}

_showFollowButton.uiInfo: {"hint":"Shows a button that allows users to toggle whether the frame follows their view as they move."}

_useTagAlong.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Tag-Along Mode", "hint":"Replaces smooth follow with tag-along: the frame stays still during small head movements and recenters after larger turns."}

_spawnOnStart.uiInfo: {"hint":"Play the Horizon Reveal spawn animation when the frame starts."}

allowNonUniformScaling.uiInfo: {"hint":"Allows independent width/height scaling, clamped to min/max sizes.", "showIf":"_allowScaling"}

worldSnapping.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables snapping to physical surfaces in the real-world environment when moving.", "showIf":"useSnapping"}

xOnTranslate.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame rotates around the X-axis to face the user, but only during movement/translation unless xAlways is also enabled.", "showIf":"useBillboarding"}

_tiltDownThreshold.uiInfo: {"label":"Tilt Down Threshold (degrees)", "hint":"Camera pitch angle looking down at which gaze-tracking activates.", "widget":"slider", "min":0, "max":90, "step":1, "showIf":"_useTiltMode"}

_tiltUpThreshold.uiInfo: {"label":"Tilt Up Threshold (degrees)", "hint":"Camera pitch angle looking up at which gaze-tracking activates.", "widget":"slider", "min":0, "max":90, "step":1, "showIf":"_useTiltMode"}

_useFocusFrame.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Focus Frame", "hint":"When enabled, a text field inside this frame moves the whole frame toward the system keyboard while editing, pausing the frame's follow behavior until editing ends."}

autoScaleContent.uiInfo: {"hint":"Automatically scales child content when the frame is resized to maintain proportions."}

itemSnapping.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables snapping to other frames when moving. Not supported together with Depth Clamping/Scaling, which are disabled while this is active.", "showIf":"useSnapping"}

relativeZ.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, Z-axis scaling of content will match X-axis scaling during frame resizing."}

useBillboarding.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables the frame to automatically rotate to face the camera/user."}

useSnapping.uiInfo: {"hint":"Enables frame snapping functionality for automatic alignment to other frames or world features when moved."}

xAlways.uiInfo: {"hint":"When enabled, the frame continuously rotates around the X-axis to face the user, regardless of movement.", "showIf":"xOnTranslate"}

yBufferDegrees.uiInfo: {"hint":"A buffered degrees on the y-axis before the frame billboards to face the user.", "showIf":"yAlways"}

logLevelFilter.uiInfo: {"label":"Log Level Filter", "hint":"Controls the verbosity of logs. Higher values show more detailed logs, while lower values only show critical information.\\n- Error (3): Errors that may affect functionality.\\n- Warning (4): Potential issues that don't affect normal operation.\\n- Info (6): General information about application state.\\n- Debug (7): Detailed information useful for debugging.\\n- Verbose (8): Maximum detail including fine-grained operational data.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Error", "value":3}, {"label":"Warning", "value":4}, {"label":"Info", "value":6}, {"label":"Debug", "value":7}, {"label":"Verbose", "value":8}]}

_debugModeEnabled.uiInfo: {"label":"Debug Mode Enabled", "hint":"When enabled, activates debug mode for all IK Interactors and Interactables, drawing visual gizmos to help visualize raycasts, colliders, and interaction geometry in the scene. Useful for troubleshooting interaction issues during development."}

_drawDebug.uiInfo: {"label":"Draw Debug", "hint":"When enabled, draws debug gizmos in the scene to visualize raycasts, colliders, and other interactor geometry. Useful for troubleshooting targeting issues during development."}

directColliderEnterRadius.uiInfo: {"label":"Direct Collider Enter Radius", "hint":"The radius (in cm) around the midpoint of the index/thumb to target Interactables. When the hand enters this radius around an Interactable, it becomes targetable for direct pinch interactions."}

directColliderExitRadius.uiInfo: {"label":"Direct Collider Exit Radius", "hint":"The radius (in cm) around the midpoint of the index/thumb to de-target Interactables. This should be larger than the enter radius to create bistable (hysteresis) behavior that prevents flickering when hovering near the boundary."}

directDragThreshold.uiInfo: {"label":"Direct Drag Threshold", "hint":"Controls the minimum distance (in cm) the hand must move during direct interaction to be considered a drag. Lower values make dragging more sensitive and easier to trigger, while higher values require more deliberate movement before dragging begins."}

indirectDragThreshold.uiInfo: {"label":"Indirect Drag Threshold", "hint":"Controls the minimum distance (in cm) the hand must move during indirect interaction to be considered a drag. When the distance between the interaction origin position and current position exceeds this threshold, dragging behavior is detected and tracked. Lower values make dragging more sensitive and easier to trigger, while higher values require more deliberate movement before dragging begins."}

handType.uiInfo: {"label":"Hand Type", "hint":"Specifies which hand this interactor tracks (left or right).", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Left", "value":"left"}, {"label":"Right", "value":"right"}]}

forcePokeOnNonDominantPalmProximity.uiInfo: {"label":"Force Poke On Non-Dominant Palm Proximity", "hint":"When enabled, forces the usage of Poke targeting when the dominant hand's index finger is near the nondominant hand's palm. Useful for hand-mounted UI interactions."}

This should be larger than the enter radius to create bistable (hysteresis) behavior that prevents flickering when hovering near the boundary."}

Lower values make dragging more sensitive and easier to trigger, while higher values require more deliberate movement before dragging begins."}

mouseTargetingMode.uiInfo: {"label":"Mouse Targeting Mode", "hint":"Sets the return value of MouseInteractor.activeTargetingMode for testing purposes. Useful when your code has checks for specific targeting modes (e.g., interactor.activeTargetingMode === TargetingMode.Direct). Allows you to simulate different hand targeting modes with the mouse in the Lens Studio preview.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Direct", "value":1}, {"label":"Indirect", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}, {"label":"Poke", "value":4}]}

'Full' lazily instantiates the full skinned hand mesh. Can be changed at runtime.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":"None"}, {"label":"Full", "value":"Full"}]}

enableInstantDrag.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Instant Drag", "hint":"Enable this to allow the Interactable to instantly be dragged on trigger rather than obeying the Interactor's drag threshold."}

useFilteredPinch.uiInfo: {"label":"Use Filtered Pinch", "hint":"Determines if the Interactable should listen to filtered pinch events when targeted by a HandInteractor. Filtered pinch events are more stable when the hand is quickly moving but may add latency in non-moving cases. Most interactions should use raw pinch events by default. Spatial interactions with large hand movement (such as dragging, scrolling) should use filtered pinch events. If an Interactable has a parent Interactable that uses filtered pinch events, this Interactable will also use filtered pinch events."}

acceptableXDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"X", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the X-axis:
- None: Disables X-axis poke detection.
- Right: Finger must approach from +X direction.
- Left: Finger must approach from -X direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Right", "value":1}, {"label":"Left", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

acceptableYDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"Y", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the Y-axis:
- None: Disables Y-axis poke detection.
- Top: Finger must approach from +Y direction.
- Bottom: Finger must approach from -Y direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Top", "value":1}, {"label":"Bottom", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

enablePokeDirectionality.uiInfo: {"label":"Enable Poke Directionality", "hint":"Enable Poke Directionality to help prevent accidental interactions when users approach from unwanted angles. When enabled, you can specify which directions are valid for poke interactions on each axis."}

acceptableZDirections.uiInfo:
{"label":"Z", "hint":"Controls from which directions a poke interaction can trigger this Interactable along the Z-axis:
- None: Disables Z-axis poke detection.
- Front: Finger must approach from +Z direction.
- Back: Finger must approach from -Z direction.
- All: Accepts both directions.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Front", "value":1}, {"label":"Back", "value":2}, {"label":"All", "value":3}], "showIf":"enablePokeDirectionality"}

allowMultipleInteractors.uiInfo: {"label":"Allow Multiple Interactors", "hint":"Determines whether this Interactable can be simultaneously controlled by multiple Interactors. When false, only one Interactor type (e.g., left hand or right hand) can interact at a time. Set to true to enable interactions from multiple sources simultaneously, such as allowing both hands to manipulate the Interactable at once."}

ignoreInteractionPlane.uiInfo: {"label":"Ignore Interaction Plane", "hint":"When enabled, this Interactable ignores any parent InteractionPlane and factors into the cursor's position and targetingVisual. Use when the Interactable is parented for organization but not spatially within that plane."}

includeCollidersInPhysics.uiInfo: {"label":"Include Colliders In Physics", "hint":"When enabled, this Interactable's colliders also participate in Lens physics: they collide with physics bodies and respond to Physics raycasts and overlap and collision events. Leave off (default) if the colliders are only used for interaction; this keeps them out of the physics simulation for better performance."}

isScrollable.uiInfo: {"label":"Is Scrollable", "hint":"When true, interactions with this element can scroll a parent ScrollView that has content extending beyond its visible bounds."}

keepHoverOnTrigger.uiInfo: {"label":"Keep Hover On Trigger", "hint":"When enabled, the Interactable exhibits sticky behavior during trigger - the cursor locks on the Interactable and remains in an active visual state even after de-hovering. This is the singular source of truth for feedback, UI, and cursor components."}

targetingMode.uiInfo:
{"label":"Targeting Mode", "hint":"Defines how Interactors can target and interact with this Interactable. Options include:
- Direct: Only allows close pinch interactions where a hand directly touches the Interactable.
- Indirect: Allows interactions from a distance with raycasting.
- Direct/Indirect: Supports both direct and indirect interaction methods.
- Poke: Enables finger poking interactions.
- All: Supports all targeting modes (Direct, Indirect, and Poke).", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"Direct", "value":1}, {"label":"Indirect", "value":2}, {"label":"Direct/Indirect", "value":3}, {"label":"Poke", "value":4}, {"label":"All", "value":7}]}

targetingVisual.uiInfo:
{"label":"Targeting Visual", "hint":"Sets the preferred targeting visual. An enclosing InteractionPlane overrides this unless Ignore Interaction Plane is set.

- None: No visual feedback.
- Cursor (default): Shows a cursor at the interaction point.
- Ray: Shows a ray from the interactor to the target.", "widget":"combobox", "values":[{"label":"None", "value":0}, {"label":"Cursor", "value":1}, {"label":"Ray", "value":2}]}
